correctness.rationale: Generic support functionals recover every vertex as a signed indegree vector of an acyclic cycle orientation; uniqueness of the cyclic binary-word transition representation and exact sign counts imply every radius and multiplicity. Central symmetry proves unique enclosing center and exact diameter/contact equalities. Independent endpoint-enumeration and hull computations for bounded n corroborate the general proof.

value.rationale: Classifies every Euclidean vertex radius with exact multiplicity in a natural infinite cycle family explicitly instantiated from a recently researched class. The resulting parity-sensitive extremal contacts and exact diameter are substantive geometric information that Ehrhart/lattice-counting data and H-descriptions do not by themselves provide; not an arbitrary special-case numerical recomputation.
